method_card.mechanism: Use AlphaFold 3 on a registered natural mature food protein, with one JSON specimen containing accession and sequence. The versioned registry lists supported proteins.
method_card.objective: Produce new predicted coordinates and confidence estimates for an independently sourced evaluation.
method_card.estimator: Template-free, empty-MSA monomer, seed 1, 10 recycles, one diffusion sample. Native mature chain, without added ions or ligands.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Mounted AF3 parameters. Prior training exposure to particular public coordinates is unknown; input contains no templates.

manifest.licence: GX wrapper; AlphaFold 3 code and weights subject to their local upstream terms. Outputs include model terms.
manifest.licence_basis: Mounted AF3 source LICENSE, parameter and output terms (included with every model result).
manifest.limitations: Only naturally occurring registered mature food chains. No sequence design, change of residues, ligand/cofactor inference, experimental evidence, or activity prediction.
